title: Evidence of humans in the Americas 130,000 years ago

tellings.quote: even much older evidence for humans in the Americas going back as much as 130,000 years into the past, 10 times older than the supposed first habitation of the Americas

plain: There is reportedly evidence of humans in the Americas as long as 130,000 years ago, ten times older than the usual date for when people first arrived there. The writer Graham Hancock says this without naming a source. If true, it would mean the history of people in the Americas is far older than taught.
